name: Summer Reading Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Help at the Carlsbad City Library during its Summer Reading Adventure. You go to an in-person training first.
who_can_apply: Teens entering grades 7 to 12. The library takes up to 105 volunteers.
duration: The 2026 program ran June 1 to Aug 1, 2026.
deadline_text: The 2026 window ran May 1 to May 18, 2026, or until 105 teens signed up. It is closed now. 2027 dates are not posted as of Nov 2, 2026.
how_to_apply: Check the library page for the form when the next window opens. You must go to an in-person orientation. Questions: libraryteens@carlsbadca.gov.
notes: Closed now. These are the 2026 dates, so check the page in spring 2027. Spots can fill before the window ends, so apply early.
